dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 王明，你看见我的钱包了吗？
dialogue.reading: Wáng Míng, nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de qiánbāo le ma?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Méi kànjiàn. Nǐ zài zhǎo qiánbāo ma?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Duì, hái méi zhǎodào. Wǒ hěn jí!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Hǎo! Wǒmen xiān qù shítáng zhǎo.
